description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of automated tests for git notes pruning functionality. It sets up test commits with notes, verifies the notes, performs pruning operations, and verifies the results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure, runs the command, and expects it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.
